quotations.old_english: Þá gefyllde hé mid wætere ealle þǽre cyrcean ciellan and sette weócon (tapor, v.l.) onmiddan (in media papyrum posuit), and þá mid fýre ontennde

source_text: weóce. For third passage substitute :-- Þá gefyllde hé mid wætere ealle þǽre cyrcean ciellan and sette weócon (tapor, v.l.) onmiddan (in media papyrum posuit), and þá mid fýre ontennde, Gr. D. 44, 15.
